# InvenTrust Properties to Present at BofA Securities 2026 Global Real Estate Conference


Company Release - 09/09/2026


Download the PDF version PDF Format (opens in new window)


DOWNERS GROVE, III.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--


InvenTrust Properties Corp. (“InvenTrust,” “IVT” or the “Company”) (NYSE: IVT) today announced that DJ Busch, President and Chief Executive Officer; Christy David, Chief Operating Officer, General Counsel and Secretary; and Dave Heimberger, Chief Investment Officer, will participate in an open roundtable discussion at the BofA Securities 2026 Global Real Estate Conference on Tuesday, September 15, 2026, at 11:05 a.m. Eastern Time.


**Event Details:**


Date: Tuesday, September 15, 2026
Time: 11:05 a.m. Eastern Time
Live Webcast:[Roundtable Webcast Link](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fbofa.veracast.com%2Fwebcasts%2Fbofa%2Frealestate2026%2FFZ2gqw.cfm&esheet=54601109&newsitemid=20260909527662&lan=en-US&anchor=Roundtable+Webcast+Link&index=1&md5=e22d2e611a10ef32304b288b48520dfe)


A replay of the webcast will be posted within 24 hours after the conclusion of the live event to the Company’s Investor Relations portion of the website at[https://www.inventrustproperties.com/investor-relations/](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.inventrustproperties.com%2Finvestor-relations%2F&esheet=54601109&newsitemid=20260909527662&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.inventrustproperties.com%2Finvestor-relations%2F&index=2&md5=d4fb49e7d22d5f27fabba8a71547f8d4) .


**About InvenTrust Properties Corp.**


InvenTrust Properties Corp. (the “Company,” "IVT," or "InvenTrust") is a premier Sun Belt, multi-tenant essential retail REIT that owns, leases, redevelops, acquires and manages grocery-anchored neighborhood and community centers as well as high-quality power centers that often have a grocery component. Management pursues the Company's business strategy by acquiring retail properties in Sun Belt markets, opportunistically disposing of retail properties, and maintaining a flexible capital structure. A trusted, local operator bringing real estate expertise to its tenant relationships, IVT has built a strong reputation with market participants across its portfolio. For more information, please visit[www.inventrustproperties.com](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.inventrustproperties.com&esheet=54601109&newsitemid=20260909527662&lan=en-US&anchor=www.inventrustproperties.com&index=3&md5=1f8515cd4f8259b11fac96f17b00e1df) .


**Availability of Information on InvenTrust Properties Corp.'s Website and Social Media Channels**


Investors and others should note that InvenTrust routinely announces material information to investors and the marketplace using U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission filings, press releases, public conference calls, webcasts and the InvenTrust investor relations website. The Company uses these channels as well as social media channels (e.g., the InvenTrust X account ([https://x.com/inventrustprop](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Finventrustprop&esheet=54601109&newsitemid=20260909527662&lan=en-US&anchor=https%3A%2F%2Fx.com%2Finventrustprop&index=4&md5=46342261ddf6d8bea41e9e4464a91288) ); and the InvenTrust LinkedIn account ([linkedin.com/company/inventrustproperties](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Flinkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Finventrustproperties&esheet=54601109&newsitemid=20260909527662&lan=en-US&anchor=linkedin.com%2Fcompany%2Finventrustproperties&index=5&md5=3a6f28b5a3556c8cb67fb19aa4413716) ) as a means of disclosing information about the Company's business to our colleagues, investors, and the public. While not all of the information that the Company posts to the InvenTrust investor relations website or on the Company’s social media channels is of a material nature, some information could be deemed to be material. Accordingly, the Company encourages investors, the media and others interested in InvenTrust to review the information that it shares on[www.inventrustproperties.com/investor-relations](https://cts.businesswire.com/ct/CT?id=smartlink&url=http%3A%2F%2Fwww.inventrustproperties.com%2Finvestor-relations&esheet=54601109&newsitemid=20260909527662&lan=en-US&anchor=www.inventrustproperties.com%2Finvestor-relations&index=6&md5=7d56c1c734e3d2426cd7fb56d4162c5e) and on the Company’s social media channels.
